description: This Dart source file defines data models for chat messages and conversations within a messaging feature of a platform. It includes classes with serialization/deserialization, copyWith methods, and equality operators.

classes.name: ChatMessage
classes.description: Represents a single chat message with properties such as id, content, sender, timestamp, and read status. Includes methods for JSON serialization and copying.

classes.name: Conversation
classes.description: Represents a conversation thread between participants, with properties such as id, participant IDs, optional match ID, and timestamps. Includes serialization, equality, and utility methods.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the instance with specified fields replaced.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the object to a JSON-compatible map.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Serializes the object to a JSON string.

methods.name: fromJsonString
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string.
